text:
Welcome back all,
Pet arrivals came up late last night, so just a quick note

Please keep an extra eye on the handoff desk and make sure each crate is checked against the arrival notes before it moves onward. Our travelers count on calm, careful support, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is at its best when we stay steady, warm, and consistent. If a crate shows any sign of delay, damage, or missing paperwork, please flag it right away so the next team member can step in smoothly.

For claim cases, <<FACT F118>> Please keep that guidance in mind when speaking with travelers, and keep your language simple and reassuring. If a traveler reports a minor injury during handling or transfer, <<FACT F113>> We want every conversation to sound attentive and respectful, especially when the traveler is worried or unsure. The same approach applies when we are helping with updates for Simba or any other pet under our care.

Thank you for staying alert and for treating each journey as a shared responsibility. Your care helps Aurelia Skyways maintain trust from the first check-in to the final handoff, and it makes a real difference for both travelers and animals.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
